sql: SELECT id,received_at FROM inbound_events WHERE owner_id=? AND (received_at,id)<=(?,?) ORDER BY received_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT ?

plan.detail: SEARCH inbound_events USING INDEX inbound_events_owner_idx (owner_id=? AND received_at<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR RIGHT PART OF ORDER BY

limitation: Rows returned are not rows scanned. Libsql public ResultSet exposes no scan counter.
